references.text: A similar concluding formula where the Lord gives a command to Moses, showing the repeated pattern of divine instruction through Moses.
The Lord speaks to Moses, a standard introduction that shows how God communicated His commands to Moses throughout the wilderness journey.
The same introductory formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses and said' used repeatedly in Numbers to introduce divine instructions.
Earlier in the same chapter, the Lord speaks to Moses about the war against the Midianites, and verse 25 continues with instructions on the distribution of the plunder.
Another occurrence of the characteristic formula where the Lord speaks to Moses and gives detailed instructions concerning holy matters.
